name: create_task
description: Create a new task in the tracker. Use this when the user asks to add, schedule or assign work. For changing an existing task use update_task; for finding tasks use search_tasks.

due_date.description: Due date as ISO date, e.g. 2026-09-30. Convert relative dates ("завтра") to ISO first

name: get_task_report
description: Get aggregated task statistics: totals by status and by assignee. Use this for overview questions ('how many tasks are overdue?'). For finding individual tasks use search_tasks.

name: search_tasks
description: Search tasks in the tracker by assignee and/or status. Use this to find, count or list tasks — e.g. all overdue tasks for a person. All filters are optional and combined with AND; call without filters to list every task. For aggregated statistics use get_task_report instead.

due_before.description: Only tasks due strictly before this ISO date, e.g. 2026-09-30

status.description: Task status; "overdue" means the due date has passed

name: update_task
description: Update fields of an existing task by its id (e.g. change status, due date or assignee). Find the task id via search_tasks first. For creating new tasks use create_task.

due_date.description: New due date as ISO date, e.g. 2026-09-30
